tasks.label: Redeploy current branch

tasks.description: $(cloud-upload) npm run worker:deploy — test, then deploy worker/ to corpus.majerus.us

tasks.description: $(cloud-upload) npm run worker:deploy-proxy — the proxy the server's drain writes D1 through
